items.en: Ukraine hits two Russian missile-component plants in two nights: Almaz-Antey's Iskra in Ulyanovsk (Kh-59, Pantsir parts) and the Azov Optical-Mechanical Plant, which leaked files tie to at least seven missile programs including Kh-101 and Oreshnik
items.nl: Oekraïne treft in twee nachten twee Russische fabrieken van raketcomponenten: Iskra van Almaz-Antej in Oeljanovsk (onderdelen Kh-59, Pantsir) en de Optisch-Mechanische Fabriek Azov, die volgens gelekte documenten aan minstens zeven raketprogramma's levert, waaronder Kh-101 en Oresjnik
items.sEn: Ukrainian long-range drones struck JSC NPP 'Iskra Plant' in Ulyanovsk overnight on 24–25 September 2026, as part of a wider drone barrage on Russia.
